name: Terraria
description: Vanilla Terraria dedicated server. Lightweight — happily runs several worlds on a small VPS.

install.label: Download the Terraria dedicated server
install.run:
BUILD="{{TERRARIA_BUILD}}"
if [ "$BUILD" = "latest" ] || [ -z "$BUILD" ]; then
  BUILD=$(curl -sf https://terraria.org/api/get/dedicated-servers-names | node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);const m=String(j[0]||"").match(/(\d+)\.zip$/);console.log(m?m[1]:"");})')
fi
[ -n "$BUILD" ] || gp_die "Could not work out the current Terraria build"
gp_log "Terraria server build $BUILD"
gp_fetch "https://terraria.org/api/download/pc-dedicated-server/terraria-server-$BUILD.zip" terraria.zip
gp_extract terraria.zip .
rm -f terraria.zip
if [ -d "$BUILD/Linux" ]; then cp -r "$BUILD/Linux/." .; rm -rf "$BUILD"; fi
chmod +x TerrariaServer.bin.x86_64 2>/dev/null || true
mkdir -p worlds
